## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：邀请收件箱里的「接受」被以「邮箱未验证」拒绝时，控制台不再弹出英文错误，而是像接受页一样转到验证邮件页（链接验证后回到该邀请的接受页）；该动作的 AI 说明写明了这个条件；验证提示页只在注册入口（确实已发邮件）说「已发送」，登录和接受邀请入口改为「请发送验证链接」，按下按钮后才显示已发送；README 写明嵌入接受页或动作运行时的宿主必须声明 `/verify-email-prompt` 路由。
- 为什么改：#34666 之后邮件可投递时接受邀请需要已验证邮箱，这三处没有跟上，新成员会卡住或被误导（卡 #34706）。
- 风险与回滚：低。拒绝路由只认一个错误码，其它拒绝照旧弹提示；文案改动新增两个翻译键（11 个语言）。英文资源包预算余量只剩约 143 字节。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` 的 `refused`(新增的错误码分支);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `refused`;`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/VerifyEmailPromptPage.tsx` 的 `sentOnArrival`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.apiActionDoor-27611.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/verificationCallback-10893.test.tsx`，预期两个文件全绿（含 objectstack#34706 的 6 个用例）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Item 1 — the invitation inbox's Accept (`sys_invitation.accept_invitation`).**

- (b) Where the console surfaces a refused `type: 'api'` action: both api handlers, `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s `apiHandler` (list rows) and `RecordDetailView`'s (record header), each reading a non-2xx through one `refused` step that already had one per-code rule (the entitlement dialog, `entitlementDialogFromError`). A second rule now sits beside it: a body whose `code` is `EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ACCEPTING_OR_REJECTING_INVITATION` (read with the existing `isAcceptNeedsVerifiedEmail`) navigates to `/verify-email-prompt?email=ADDRESS&redirect=/accept-invitation/INVITATION_ID` and answers `{ success: false }` with no `error`, which the runner reads as "no toast". It applies through the action door and through the direct call alike (the door relays the target's flat vendor body as-is). The redirect is the accept page for that invitation (the subject row's id), so after verifying the person lands where the accept page's own refusal lands. Every other refusal reads exactly as before. No action metadata key, no `packages/spec` change, no server change.
- (a) `ai.description` now states the server rule on `main`: while the deployment delivers email, the caller's address must be verified; an unverified caller is refused with that code and nothing is written. No translated bundle carries `ai.description` (`check:i18n` in sync).
- Helpers in `orgErrorMessage.ts`: `verifyEmailPromptPath(email, redirect)` and `invitationVerifyEmailPromptPath(email, invitationId)`. `AcceptInvitationPage.tsx` is left as `main` has it (see Acceptance notes).

**Item 2 — `/verify-email-prompt` copy.** Measured which arrivals send a mail before reaching the page:

| arrival | mail sent before arrival? | evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/register` (verification required) | yes | better-auth 1.7.12 `sign-up`: sends when `emailVerification.sendOnSignUp ?? requireEmailVerification` |
| `/login` (`EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`) | no, unless the deployment sets `emailVerification.sendOnSignIn` (plugin-auth forwards it only when set; unset by default) | better-auth 1.7.12 `sign-in`: the send is inside `if (emailVerification.sendOnSignIn)` |
| accept page / inbox action (refused accept) | no | the plugin-auth refusal hook writes and sends nothing |

The old page said "We sent a verification link…" and "Sent to:" on every arrival. Now `RegisterPage` adds `?sent=1` (`VERIFICATION_SENT_PARAM`, `verifyEmailPromptQuery.ts`) and keeps today's copy. Every other arrival reads "Your email address has not been verified yet. Send a verification link to ADDRESS, then click the link to verify your account." with a "Send verification email" button, and shows "Sent to:" and the spam hint only after the button has sent the mail. With no `sent` key the page says nothing about a sent mail. New keys `auth.verifyEmail.sendDescription` and `auth.verifyEmail.sendButton` in all 11 built-in locales (key-parity tests green).

**Item 3 — the embedding host's route.** `@object-ui/app-shell` README gains "Hosting the invitation pages: declare `/verify-email-prompt`": the accept page and the action handlers navigate there with `email` and `redirect`; a host that mounts either one must declare the route. The changeset says the same.

Changeset `.changeset/34706-accept-invitation-followups.md`: `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/i18n`, all `patch`.

## Tests

- `useConsoleActionRuntime.apiActionDoor-27611.test.tsx`: new top-level describe (objectstack#34706): the refusal through the door, and through the direct call, navigates to the prompt with the account's address and the invitation's accept page, returns `{ success: false }`, no refresh. CONTROL: `YOU_ARE_NOT_THE_RECIPIENT_OF_THE_INVITATION` keeps its sentence and navigates nowhere. The file's `react-router-dom` mock now hands back a navigate spy; the mocked user gains an email.
- `RecordDetailView.apiActionDoor-27611.test.tsx`: the same three cases on the record page, reading the navigation from a `useLocation` probe under the `MemoryRouter`.
- `verificationCallback-10893.test.tsx`: new describe: an arrival with no `sent` asks to send and claims no mail (no "We sent", no "Sent to:", no spam hint, no request made); pressing the button sends to the address and only then shows "Sent to:" and the spam hint. CONTROL: `sent=1` keeps the "we sent" copy and "Resend". The sign-up redirect test also asserts `sent=1`.
- Existing tests that drove the prompt as the sign-up's resend now pass `sent=1` (`verificationCallback-10893`, `handoffVerificationMail-30157`); `handoffVerificationMail-30157`'s `promptAt` takes the `sent` flag for the `/register` hops.

## Acceptance notes

- **In-flight overlap: #34883** (draft) makes the same refusal unconditional (every deployment) and adds it to decline. Two effects on this PR if it lands first or after: the `ai.description` sentence "While this deployment delivers email" then needs its condition dropped, and `reject_invitation` would answer the same code. The console routing here is keyed on the code, not the action, so a refused decline from the inbox already goes to verification too. This branch first refactored `AcceptInvitationPage.tsx` onto the new helper; `overlap-check` reported a textual conflict with #34883 on that file, so the page is left as `main` has it (`overlap-check` exit 0 on the final head).
- **Eager English budget.** `i18n-locale-en` measures 61,857 gzipped bytes against the 62,000 ceiling (headroom 143). Removing the two new strings from the built chunk and re-gzipping gives 61,818, so they cost about 39 bytes. Other open PRs that add English keys (#34925 shares the locale files) draw on the same 143 bytes.
- The sign-up arrival's `sent=1` assumes the vendor default (`sendOnSignUp` follows `requireEmailVerification`). A deployment that sets `sendOnSignUp: false` while requiring verification would see "We sent" after sign-up although nothing was sent. That was already the case before this PR; noted, not changed.
- `resendFailed` ("Cannot resend verification email") still says "resend" when the first send fails on an arrival that sent nothing. It only appears after the button is pressed.
- No `content/docs/**` page documents the default auth pages; the package README is where the host-route rule lives.
